messages:
emma: prepping private/VPC airgap delivery for Nebula. packaging passed CI but need quick sign-off on artifact pinning and rollback criteria before courier pickup. :truck:

deploy-bot: packaging scheduled 01:40 UTC. will emit sealed crate: installer-nebula-v2.0.1+nebula-20260324.tar.gz, images.tar.lz4, submanifest.json, detached cosign.sig

chao: customer requested immutable sha256 pins in submanifest plus a short 12-char digest label for human ops.

security: include full sha256 and 12-char digest in submanifest, public key fingerprint in artifacts/attest/, signer-attestation.pdf included. manifest TTL: 21d for this delivery. do not include private keys.

ops-qa: propose rollback triggers: 1) installer checksum mismatch during verify 2) post-install smoke failure 3) >8% 5xx across the first 10 minutes OR KMS attestation failure. fallback: push `installer-nebula-v2.0.0` and run `./evacuate.sh --from-nebula`. add `docs/rollback.md` into crate root with verify and evac steps.

emma: timeline: packaging 01:40, courier pickup window 03:00-04:30 UTC, customer ingest ~06:00 UTC. add forced hold at 04:45 UTC so oncall can abort: `/deploy hold installer-nebula-v2.0.1 --until 04:45`. planning to trigger packaging in 8m.

deploy-bot: packaging queued. will post crate URL and final checksums when complete.

emma: thanks all  i'll ping ops channel when courier clears the gate and attach chain-of-custody to release notes.
